answer_text: UMG Article 3.2 requires a minimum width of 5 metres for a two-way road: (c-01)[Aucune voie d'intérêt public ou privé ne doit avoir une largeur inférieure à 5 mètres pour une circulation à double sens]. For one-way traffic the minimum is 3.50 metres: (c-02)[à 3,50 mètres pour une circulation à sens unique]. The Article 3.2 text sits on the PDF page labelled 322, whose printed footer reads 321: (c-03)[321].
additional_context: The rule is a general floor for public or private roads and does not depend on the construction type. Whether the parcel's actual access road meets 5 m was not established from the supplied corpus. The planner's rationale is conditional ('may be binding'), and it names no specific width, so it is not contradicted.
